Welcome to the Lucky 38.

Luxury without decadence. Refinement without elitism. Class without snobbery.

This deluxe poker set is inspired by the monument that Mr. House built. The set features a full complement of 200 poker chips, two decks of Lucky 38 cards, Big and Small Blind chips, embossed metal dealer coin, and a custom carrying case.

Product Description:

  • Custom Lucky 38 Poker Set carrying case with faux leather handle and two buckles for closure
  • Two sets of Lucky 38 cards with Vault boy on the back
  • Specialty velvet inside carrying case to protect chips and cards
  • One metal dealer coin with embossed Lucky 38 detailing
  • Dealer Coin diameter: 1.92"
  • 200 piece poker chips
  • Four chip color variations
  • 2 Blind Chips: 1 Big Blind (black), 1 Small Blind (white)
  • Blind Chip Material: Plastic 
  • Blind Chip Diameter: 1.79"
  • Poker chip material: ABS plastic
  • Poker chip diameter: 1.57" 
  • Case size: 12.3" x 7.9" x 2.5"
  • Case material: Fiberboard 
  • Age: 17+
  • Imported
  • Weight: 3.70 kgs (130.5 ounces / 8.16 pounds)
